SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER, A.DOC_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'ILHE') AND A.IF_FLAG IN ('N','E') AND TRIM(A.MG_NOTE) IS NOT NULL
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER AS BUYER, A.DOC_NO AS DOC_NO, A.DOC_SEQ AS DOC_SEQ, 'C' AS STATUS, A.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE, A.ADD_TIME AS ADD_TIME, NVL(B.TEXT1, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(B.CODE1,'-1') AS ITEM_ID, NVL(B.TEXT2,'') AS CATEGORY_ID, NVL(B.TEXT3,'N') AS INVENTORY_FLAG, A.CATEGORY1 AS ITEM_CAT1, A.CATEGORY2 AS ITEM_CAT2, A.CATEGORY3 AS ITEM_CAT3, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.UNIT_PRICE, (A.ITEM_QTY * A.UNIT_PRICE) AS ITEM_AMT, A.RD_DATE, NVL(TRIM(F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE, '^' , 9)),A.LEGACY_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, NVL(A.REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, TRIM(F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE, '^' , 1)) AS ORGANIZATION_ID, TRIM(F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE, '^' , 3)) AS SUBINVENTORY_CODE, (SELECT TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C020' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = TRIM(F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE, '^' , 1))) AS LOCATION_ID, TRIM(F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE, '^' , 4)) AS EXPENSE_TYPE_ID, TRIM(F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE, '^' , 6)) AS PROJECT_ID, TRIM(F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE, '^' , 8)) AS TASK_ID, A.LEGACY_USER_ID AS PREPARER FROM IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND A , ICOMCOD3 B WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.DOC_NO = '$G_RS.DOC_NO$' AND A.IF_FLAG IN ('N','E') AND 'C028' = B.TYPE(+) AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.TEXT1(+) AND TRIM(F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE, '^' , 1)) = B.CODE2(+) ORDER BY 1,2,TO_NUMBER(DOC_SEQ)
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.DOC_NO = '$G_RS.DOC_NO$' AND A.IF_FLAG IN ('N','E')
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.DOC_NO = '$G_RS.DOC_NO$' AND A.IF_FLAG IN ('N','E')
